title: A hypothetical business-rule test budget
method: Assume 300 serial cases × 20 ms = 6 seconds or × 200 ms = 60 seconds. These are invented costs; setup, parallelism and adapter tests are excluded. No measured framework speedup is claimed.
alt: A hypothetical business-rule test budget. Isolated application tests: 6 seconds; Full-stack fixture tests: 60 seconds. Illustrative inputs.
